text: The Phantom of the Opera is a scenario for Arkham Horror: The Card Game based on the classic story by Gaston Leroux. It can be played as a standalone scenario, or as a side-story during any campaign.
This scenario uses the concealed effect, and requires the concealed decoy mini-cards included in The Scarlet Keys campaign expansion.
If you are playing The Scarlet Keys campaign, this scenario can be played by visiting Paris on the world map (as if there were a side-story location connected to London, Venice, and Monte Carlo).
This scenario would not have been possible without the amazing design framework created by Matt Newman, Nate French and everyone involved in Arkham Horror: The Card Game at FFG.

notes: This scenario is an unofficial fan creation and in no way endorsed by Fantasy Flight Games. All rights to artwork belong to the relevant artists.
